python3 - <<'REMOTE'
import hashlib
import json
import os
import re
import subprocess

inv = {'paths': {'topics': ['/home/ssm-user/kafka_2.12-2.8.1/bin/kafka-topics.sh'], 'configs': ['/home/ssm-user/kafka_2.12-2.8.1/bin/kafka-configs.sh'], 'jars': ['/home/ssm-user/kafka_2.12-2.8.1/libs/aws-msk-iam-auth-2.3.0-all.jar'], 'properties': ['/home/ssm-user/kafka_2.12-2.8.1/bin/client.properties']}, 'properties': [{'path': '/home/ssm-user/kafka_2.12-2.8.1/bin/client.properties', 'required_settings_match': True, 'credential_override_present': False, 'unknown_keys': []}], 'principal_arn': 'arn:aws:sts::048715026902:assumed-role/ktd-msk-producer-role/i-08e374efb0c31160d', 'java_present': True, 'javac_present': False, 'credential_env_present': {'AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID': False, 'AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY': False, 'AWS_SESSION_TOKEN': False, 'AWS_PROFILE': False, 'AWS_SHARED_CREDENTIALS_FILE': False, 'AWS_CONFIG_FILE': False, 'JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS': False, 'KAFKA_OPTS': False}, 'shared_credential_files_exist': []}
env = dict(os.environ)
env['CLASSPATH'] = inv['paths']['jars'][0]
env['KAFKA_HEAP_OPTS'] = '-Xms64M -Xmx256M'
broker = 'boot-aersevd2.c2.kafka-serverless.ap-northeast-2.amazonaws.com:9098'
props = inv['paths']['properties'][0]
common = ['--bootstrap-server', broker, '--command-config', props]
expected = {'cleanup.policy': 'delete', 'retention.ms': '604800000', 'retention.bytes': '-1'}
summary = {}


def execute(label, command, filtered=False):
    proc = subprocess.run(command, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=50, env=env)
    stdout = proc.stdout
    if filtered:
        stdout = '\n'.join(line for line in proc.stdout.splitlines() if any(re.search(r'\b' + re.escape(k) + r'=', line) for k in (*expected, 'min.insync.replicas')))
    data = {'label': label, 'command': command, 'returncode': proc.returncode, 'stdout': stdout, 'stderr': proc.stderr}
    if filtered:
        data['full_stdout_sha256'] = hashlib.sha256(proc.stdout.encode()).hexdigest()
        data['output_filter'] = 'cleanup.policy,retention.ms,retention.bytes,min.insync.replicas only'
    print('STEP_JSON=' + json.dumps(data), flush=True)
    return proc


for topic in ('kitchen.sensor.validated', 'kitchen.sensor.quarantine'):
    describe = [inv['paths']['topics'][0], *common, '--describe', '--topic', '^' + re.escape(topic) + '$']
    initial = execute(topic + '-before-create', describe)
    created = False
    if initial.returncode:
        combined = initial.stdout + initial.stderr
        assert 'does not exist as expected' in combined
        assert not any(s in combined for s in ('AuthorizationException', 'TimeoutException', 'SaslAuthenticationException'))
        command = [inv['paths']['topics'][0], *common, '--create', '--if-not-exists', '--topic', topic, '--partitions', '3', '--config', 'cleanup.policy=delete', '--config', 'retention.ms=604800000', '--config', 'retention.bytes=-1']
        create = execute(topic + '-create', command)
        assert create.returncode == 0, 'CREATE_FAILED_STOP'
        created = ('Created topic ' + topic + '.') in create.stdout
    final = execute(topic + '-after-describe', describe)
    assert final.returncode == 0, 'DESCRIBE_FAILED_STOP'
    header = next(line for line in final.stdout.splitlines() if 'PartitionCount:' in line)
    assert ('Topic: ' + topic) in header or ('Topic:\t' + topic) in header
    count = int(re.search(r'PartitionCount:\s*(\d+)', header)[1])
    rf = int(re.search(r'ReplicationFactor:\s*(\d+)', header)[1])
    assert count == 3
    partitions = []
    for line in final.stdout.splitlines():
        if 'Partition:' not in line:
            continue
        index = int(re.search(r'Partition:\s*(\d+)', line)[1])
        leader = re.search(r'Leader:\s*([^\s]+)', line)[1]
        replicas = [int(x) for x in re.search(r'Replicas:\s*([0-9,]+)', line)[1].split(',')]
        isr = [int(x) for x in re.search(r'Isr:\s*([0-9,]+)', line)[1].split(',')]
        assert leader != 'none' and int(leader) >= 0
        assert len(replicas) == rf
        partitions.append({'partition': index, 'leader': int(leader), 'replicas': replicas, 'isr': isr})
    assert sorted(p['partition'] for p in partitions) == [0, 1, 2]
    command = [inv['paths']['configs'][0], *common, '--entity-type', 'topics', '--entity-name', topic, '--describe', '--all']
    config = execute(topic + '-after-config', command, filtered=True)
    assert config.returncode == 0, 'CONFIG_FAILED_STOP'
    actual = {}
    for key in (*expected, 'min.insync.replicas'):
        match = re.search(r'\b' + re.escape(key) + r'=([^\s,}]+)', config.stdout)
        actual[key] = match[1] if match else None
    assert all(actual[k] == v for k, v in expected.items()), 'CONFIG_MISMATCH_STOP'
    if actual['min.insync.replicas'] is not None:
        assert all(len(p['isr']) >= int(actual['min.insync.replicas']) for p in partitions)
    summary[topic] = {'created': created, 'partitions': partitions, 'partition_count': count, 'replication_factor': rf, 'configs': actual, 'verified': True}
visible = execute('final-topic-list', [inv['paths']['topics'][0], *common, '--list'])
assert visible.returncode == 0
assert {'kitchen.sensor.raw', 'kitchen.sensor.validated', 'kitchen.sensor.quarantine'}.issubset(set(visible.stdout.splitlines()))
print('RESULT_JSON=' + json.dumps(summary), flush=True)
REMOTE
